models.title: Percentage commission earned by a consignment agent
models.summary: The consignment agent earns a 25% commission on sales and reports only the commission as its revenue.

relationship.original_equation: Agent commission = eligible consignment sales × commission rate
relationship.locator: Notes to consolidated financial statements, revenue recognition, sales channels
relationship.translation_notes: Sales and commission are same-period currency amounts; the commission rate is a base-one fraction.

variables.definition: Sales amount to which the contractual commission rate applies

variables.definition: Fraction of eligible sales earned by the agent
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

variables.definition: Commission earned by the agent on eligible completed sales
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: The company acts as an agent, rather than as principal, and the stated percentage applies to the defined eligible sales base.
The commission has been earned under the contract and the applicable revenue-recognition requirements; sales and commission use the same currency and period.
limitations: The formula excludes fixed fees, tiered rates, returns, incentives, taxes and other contractual adjustments unless already reflected in the eligible base or rate.
The Allegro source describes a commission based on customer payment; a sales-based contract and a payment-based contract need not have the same base or timing.
